verdict.rationale: Buzz delivers this through its agents rather than a dedicated insights feature. Agents can search six months of history and post the relevant threads, you can @mention an agent in a channel and it replies using the Buzz CLI, and a benchmark grades agents answering from seeded memory. However, you must set up and run an ACP agent with your own chosen LLM provider, and nothing shows the product proactively generating insights or suggestions. Missing for 10: a built-in AI insights or suggestions feature, evidence of proactive analysis of workspace data, and independent hands-on corroboration of agent-generated insights.
